_note: Interference policy for web/wright-1903-reconstruction.glb.gz (rest pose and the operating clip). Touching is always allowed; overlap is not. known_defects is a ratchet: it records what the CURRENTLY PUBLISHED asset still contains, may only shrink, and an entry that is no longer observed fails the audit until it is removed.
